if(CONFIG_MPIPE_AUD)
  zephyr_library_sources(
    mpipe_aud_buffer_pool.c
    mpipe_aud_dmic_src.c
    mpipe_aud_gain.c
    mpipe_aud_i2s_codec_sink.c
    mpipe_aud_src.c
    mpipe_aud.c
  )

  zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_MPIPE_RPC
    mpipe_aud_buffer_pool_client.c
    mpipe_aud_transform_client.c
  )

  if(CONFIG_MPIPE_ERPC)
    # The client side of the audio transform interface, compiled by the erpcgen
    # host tool. The server side comes from the same file, generated by the
    # application of the remote core.
    find_program(ERPCGEN erpcgen REQUIRED)
    set(mpipe_aud_erpc_idl ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/erpc/mpipe_aud_transform.erpc)
    set(mpipe_aud_erpc_dir ${ZEPHYR_BINARY_DIR}/generated/mpipe/erpc)
    set(mpipe_aud_erpc_sources
      ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}/c_mpipe_aud_transform_client.cpp
      ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}/mpipe_aud_transform_client.cpp
      ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}/mpipe_aud_transform_interface.cpp
    )
    add_custom_command(
      OUTPUT
        ${mpipe_aud_erpc_sources}
        ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}/c_mpipe_aud_transform_client.h
        ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}/mpipe_aud_transform_common.h
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir}
      COMMAND ${ERPCGEN} -g c -o ${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir} ${mpipe_aud_erpc_idl}
      DEPENDS ${mpipe_aud_erpc_idl}
      COMMENT "Generating the eRPC client of the audio transform"
    )
    add_custom_target(mpipe_aud_erpc_gen DEPENDS ${mpipe_aud_erpc_sources})
    add_dependencies(${ZEPHYR_CURRENT_LIBRARY} mpipe_aud_erpc_gen)
    zephyr_library_include_directories(${mpipe_aud_erpc_dir})
    zephyr_library_sources(
      mpipe_aud_transform_client_erpc.c
      ${mpipe_aud_erpc_sources}
    )
    zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_MPIPE_AUD_REMOTE_LOG
      mpipe_aud_transform_client_erpc_log.c
    )
  endif()
endif()
